gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-zanabaza: College draws every curve as heavy as its straight stems, leaving big open counters in a tall lowercase that feels dynamic. Noto Sans Zanabazar Square adds a soaring x-height and wide, crisp gaps.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-traditional-n: Noto Traditional Nushu reads like a broad-nibbed pen stroke that never curls shut. College takes the top as letters bent from one length of tubing, against bowls that fill the line.
gen-dafont-college-gf-onest: Dynamic and authoritative, College gives every curve the weight of a straight stem, with big counters in a tall lowercase. Onest then moves smoothly through paragraphs, short ascenders over big bowls.
gen-dafont-college-gf-parkinsans: Heavy, confident curves define College, whose lowercase stands tall around big, generous counters. Parkinsans adds sans-serif lines of one stroke thickness, crisp when shrunk and rising close to capitals.
gen-dafont-college-gf-radio-canada-big: Radio Canada Big has a monoline skeleton and an x-height filling the line. Its terminals stop short of the stem, so paragraphs stay easy to follow beneath the heavy curves of College.
gen-dafont-college-gf-sarpanch: Sarpanch reads with a clearly open mouth on the lowercase e and a compact gap from x-height to ascender line. College brings a lack of stress in every curve up top.
gen-dafont-college-gf-sintony: Sintony brings a chunky, tall midzone while College draws its lines as if traced with one marker tip. Longer text then runs smoothly, with no clogged curves anywhere along the way.
gen-dafont-college-gf-sofia-sans-semi-co: College makes each curve as sturdy as a straight stem, opening big counters in a tall lowercase. Sofia Sans Semi Condensed adds near-capital lowercase and a big visible entrance into each curve.
gen-dafont-college-gf-stack-sans-notch: College opens big counters in a tall lowercase, with curves carrying the full weight of its stems. Stack Sans Notch below offers open curves you can see right into.
gen-dafont-college-gf-sulphur-point: Curves as sturdy as straight stems give College its dynamic punch, with big counters in a tall lowercase. And Sulphur Point, with its marker-like line weight, lets College earn its keep big and short.
